hypothesis: The chosen native head contains a context-stable query component on which changing the queried person acts as an affine orthogonal involution. This tests a joint state/control relation, not sparsity of the full query or a generic identity-label decoder.

scope.native_site: Qwen3-0.6B L19H5 post-query-normalization/pre-RoPE, last row only
scope.heldout: Do not open native outputs. Current law swaps a specific pair of names; generic new-name transfer is not assumed.

program: T(q)=q-2 U U^T(q-mbar), U orthonormal, frozen across contexts and both directions. Native high-dimensional complement retained. No donor query, owner label, target attention, or target logits used at prediction.
fit: Train-fold q0/q1 give m=(q0+q1)/2,d=(q1-q0)/2; choose top-k eigenvectors of mean(dd^T)-cov(m); mbar=train mean(m). Exact global minimum of bidirectional Euclidean query error within fixed-rank reflection family; does not optimize tail KL.
fold: XOR old_statement_order,update_statement_order,payload_swap,update_wording; group both query_owner states in one fold; query_now varies within each fold.16pairs train,16 opposite evaluation. All data previously used for discovery; not untouched generalization.
other_ranks: diagnostic expressivity curve; no post-evaluation relabeling as primary
controls: fixed train mean signed translation, explicitly label-assisted
deterministic same-rank random reflections centered at train mbar; not necessarily perturbation-norm-matched
reference: For each recipient, replace only selected last-row query with counterpart person query. Keep recipient keys, values and other native background. This is a finite invocation intervention, not the full text-counterfactual model or a checkpoint edit.
metrics: full attention KL oracle local intervention to predicted law on identical recipient K
record-prefix and nonself-prefix conditional attention separately
query error normalized by full donor norm and by actual swap displacement
native value read error and physical-slot masses
native full-vocabulary tail KL relative to full donor-query local intervention
fixed physical color0-color1 log odds error

branch_decisions.success: If frozen low-rank law substantially improves full native-tail intervention prediction over identity and random controls in both directions and context strata, identify a narrow reusable native query-control relation. Next recover how upstream/native key representations construct its arguments; do not claim generic owner coding.
branch_decisions.attention_only: No native downstream explanation established; retain as local diagnostic and inspect response relevance.
branch_decisions.failure: Reject fixed context-independent orthogonal query swap for tested ranks/scope; distinguish error concentrated in address/context coupling from simple numerical rank shortage. Do not grow affine adapters without evidence.

limitations: Head and task chosen using discovery measurements.
Reflection family and person-swap correspondence supplied by investigator.
Query center/maps count in artifact; native background retained explicitly.
Post-gain query patches may leave native normalization manifold; reference and norm diagnostics explicit.
No whole-model algorithm recovery or VPD victory from this experiment.
